caption: On a black stage a glowing orange-yellow DJ console sits at center, its two turntable tops lit green and four speaker circles outlined red. Three humanoid dancers rendered as neon outlines wear fedora hats with red glowing eyes and red-and-blue shoes, holding positions at left, center, and right. They are already mid-routine. The group performs a mirrored stepping and leaning dance. The side figures lift a knee, lean their torsos back, and swing bent arms, periodically thrusting both hands forward to point, while the center dancer gestures over the console, spreading and drawing in its arms and pointing outward. Their horizontal positions stay roughly fixed, so the movement is body choreography rather than travel across the stage. The speaker-circle outlines pulse between red and green-yellow independently of the dancers. Near the end the neon outlines recolor from teal-green to purple-magenta, and two larger purple-outlined dancers appear at the far left and right edges, expanding the visible group from three to five while the console remains fixed in size and position. The excerpt ends mid-routine.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.

or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
